The purpose of the present document is to record the discussion and agreements that arise from the study item "CU-DU lower layer split for NR" in RP-170818 [2]. The study is continued from that which was conducted within the NR Access Technology Study Item, where the results are captured in sub-clause 11.1 and Annex A of TR 38.801 [3].
Section 10 of TS 38.413 [5] is applicable for the purposes of the present document.

[CR CR0164r4 for 38.470] Reason for change: To capture agreements for Rel-19 LTM. Summary of change: Introduce CSI-RS Coordination function. Introduce CSI-RS Coordination procedures. Consequences if not approved: Stage-2 decription for Rel-19 LTM is missing in TS38.470.
